stories.h: Boeing to cut 5% of commercial airplane workforce
stories.s: Boeing plans to cut about 5% of its commercial airplane workforce in December through attrition and layoffs, after slowing production. The cut is estimated at about 2,500 jobs, with possible impact on Everett.

stories.h: Wind advisory for northwest Snohomish County lowlands
stories.s: A wind advisory covering northwest Snohomish County and the north interior runs 1 p.m. Tuesday to 7 p.m. Wednesday. Gusts could reach 50 mph, with possible downed trees and power outages.

stories.h: WSDOT unveils preferred design for US 2 trestle
stories.s: The proposed replacement for the US 2 trestle has three lanes each way, one of them HOV, plus a bike and pedestrian path. Preliminary costs run $2-4 billion, and construction could start in 2032 if funded.

stories.h: Port of Everett approves $72.5M budget for 2027
stories.s: Port commissioners adopted a 2027 budget that includes $20.1 million for 35 capital projects, among them seaport modernization and shore power. Operating revenue is projected to fall 2.7%.

stories.h: One dead in house fire north of Woodinville
stories.s: One person died early Monday in a house fire on Little Bear Creek Road, and a second resident escaped through a window. The Snohomish County Fire Marshal is investigating the cause.

coming.s: Veterans Day is a state legal holiday Wednesday, so many government offices will be closed. Check local agencies for service changes.

coming.h: Stronger wind and rain system arrives Friday
coming.s: Forecasters expect a stronger storm Friday into the weekend, bringing more wind, rain and high-elevation snow across western Washington.
